name: Northgate Home Services
tagline: Heating, cooling, and plumbing for the north side.
_note: FICTIONAL BRAND. Built as the contrast case to temerarii-media: B2C not B2B, local not national, seasonal not thought-leadership, trust-and-urgency not minus-the-hype. If a person or system can run BOTH of these correctly, they are operating the mechanism rather than memorizing one brand.

tone: Plainspoken. Say what the job is, what it costs, and how long it takes.
Warm without being folksy. These are neighbors, not leads.
Calm about urgency. A failed furnace in February is genuinely urgent; the copy does not have to manufacture that.
Specific over impressive. A model number and a real timeline beat an adjective.
Never talk down. Homeowners can handle the actual explanation.
frames: We tell you what we'd tell our own family.
Upfront pricing, before the wrench comes out.
Licensed, background-checked, and we show up in the window we gave you.
If you don't need the repair, we'll say so.
banned_words: they don't want you to know
voice._banned_rationale: Temerarii bans HYPE (revolutionary, 10x, game-changer). Northgate bans FEAR-SELLING AND PRESSURE (act now, silent killer, guaranteed forever). Same gate, opposite failure mode. A reviewer who has only pattern-matched 'no superlatives' will miss every violation in this brand -- which is exactly what the cross-brand exercise is testing.

pillars.label: Emergency Repair
pillars.description: No heat, no cooling, active leak. Same-day response.

pillars.label: Maintenance Plans
pillars.description: Twice-yearly tune-ups, priority scheduling, member pricing.

strategy.mission: Be the company north-side homeowners call twice: once when something breaks, and every season after.
strategy.icp: Homeowners, 8-40 year old houses, within 25 minutes of the shop.

values.name: Show up in the window
values.body: The arrival window we give is the one we keep. If we're late, we call before we're late.

values.name: Price before wrench
values.body: The homeowner approves the number before any work starts. No line-item surprises.

values.name: Say when it's fine
values.body: If a system has years left, we say so and leave. That is the entire referral engine.

channels._note: Shared channel calendar: all social, long form, and owned (blog / email / SMS). Brands EXTEND it rather than replace it — this one adds a podcast. `manual` lists channels we publish to by hand: payloads are built and validated, never auto-posted.

type.rule: Body copy never below 16px. Homeowners read this on a phone, often in a hurry, sometimes in a cold house.

forbidden: countdown timers on anything that is not a genuine scheduled event
any motion that implies time pressure the customer does not actually have

visual_rules.accent_cap: Orange accent on no more than one element per frame. It marks the action, not the mood.
visual_rules.photography: Real trucks, real technicians, real houses in this metro. No stock photography of models in clean coveralls.
never: before/after photos of hazards used to frighten
thermal images or mold imagery as a scare device
a technician pointing gravely at equipment
